title: Well-Made 10 Lb. Blanket Makes It Hard to Move at Night
text:
Well-Made 10 Lb. Blanket Makes It Hard to Move at Night. This SERTA ZEN REST WEIGHTED ADULT BLANKET (twin-size, 48 in by 72 in, 10 lbs, Navy) is my second weighted blanket–and it proves that even a 10-lb. blanket is too heavy for me. It makes it too hard to turn and move naturally during the night.

I love the concept of weighted blankets, because I have a thick, furry, heavy throw that always makes me feel protected and “safe”. Its only drawback is its size (50 in by 60 in), which is short for optimal use on a bed at night. I will go back to using this as my weighted blanket.

The Serta blanket is well-made of polyester and glass beads. It is noiseless. The care label says “spot clean only”.
